#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source scripts/setup-ffmpeg.sh
mkdir -p target/hx-deletion/paired
nice -n 19 python3 -I -B - <<'VERIFY'
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
m=json.loads(Path('target/hx-deletion/frozen-control/manifest.json').read_text())
with Path('target/hx-deletion/frozen-control/old-core-control').open('rb') as f:
    assert hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()==m['binary_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('crates/kinewright-core/tests/support/undo_fixture.rs').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==m['fixture_sha256']
print('Frozen control and unchanged fixture hashes verified',flush=True)
VERIFY
# Fixed five-pair order; no retry, timing selection or quiet-machine wait.
for pair in 0 1 2 3 4; do
    if (( pair % 2 == 0 )); then sides=(old product); else sides=(product old); fi
    for side in "${sides[@]}"; do
        out="target/hx-deletion/paired/${pair}-${side}"
        test ! -e "$out.json"
        if [[ "$side" == old ]]; then binary=target/hx-deletion/frozen-control/old-core-control; else binary=target/release/examples/undo_product_bench; fi
        printf 'Measuring fixed pair %s %s\n' "$pair" "$side"
        flock -o /tmp/kinewright-cargo-heavy.lock env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 nice -n 10 bash -c '
            TIMEFORMAT='"'"'{"wall_seconds":%R,"user_seconds":%U,"system_seconds":%S}'"'"'
            date -u +%FT%TZ > "$3.started"
            uptime > "$3.load-before"
            { time "$1" "$2" > "$3.json" 2> "$3.stderr"; } 2> "$3.time.json"
            result=$?
            printf "%s\n" "$result" > "$3.exit"
            uptime > "$3.load-after"
            date -u +%FT%TZ > "$3.finished"
            exit "$result"
        ' benchmark "$binary" "$side" "$out"
        nice -n 19 python3 -I -B - "$out" <<'PY'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);r=json.loads(p.with_suffix('.json').read_text());assert r['errors']==0
print(json.dumps(r['metrics'],sort_keys=True),flush=True)
PY
    done
done
